# Runtime Shader Compilation API

<!-- WARNING: generated by tools/build_api_c.py from build/bindings/datoviz_api.json -->

Typed runtime GLSL-to-SPIR-V compilation, provider availability, diagnostics, profiles, and result ownership.

!!! info "Status: advanced/unstable"

    This generated page lists exported C functions and their canonical public types
    classified by the v0.4 C API reference policy. Raw Python `ctypes` call forms are
    documented separately.

Use this advanced API for external GLSL shaders in direct native rendering code. Applications with precompiled SPIR-V do not need the runtime compiler.

Common workflows:

- [Build options](../build-options.md)
- [Runtime internals](../../advanced/runtime-internals.md)

#### `dvz_compile_glsl()` { #dvz_compile_glsl .dvz-api-function }

Compile a null-terminated GLSL string through the typed API.

This transitional convenience accepts only `vertex`, `fragment`, or `compute`, uses the matching
v0.4 target profile, reports errors through the log, and returns owned SPIR-V that must be freed
with dvz_memory_free(). New code should use dvz_shader_compile().

```c
uint32_t * dvz_compile_glsl(
    const char * stage,
    const char * glsl,
    uint64_t * out_size
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | `uint32_t` * | owned SPIR-V words, or NULL |
| `stage` | `const` `char` * | shader stage string |
| `glsl` | `const` `char` * | null-terminated GLSL source string |
| `out_size` | `uint64_t` * |  |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/shader.h`:171._

#### `dvz_shader_compile()` { #dvz_shader_compile .dvz-api-function }

Compile GLSL source bytes to owned SPIR-V.

Vertex and fragment shaders require `DVZ_SHADER_PROFILE_GRAPHICS`, which targets Vulkan 1.0 and
SPIR-V 1.0. Compute shaders require `DVZ_SHADER_PROFILE_COMPUTE`, which targets Vulkan 1.3 and
SPIR-V 1.6. `source_name` must identify the real source for diagnostics. A NULL or empty
`entry_point` selects `main`.

On every call with a non-NULL result, the result is initialized and receives the returned
status. On success it owns aligned SPIR-V words. On failure it normally owns a null-terminated
diagnostic string. Call dvz_shader_compile_result_destroy() exactly once before reusing or
discarding the result.

```c
DvzShaderCompileStatus dvz_shader_compile(
    const DvzShaderCompileRequest * request,
    DvzShaderCompileResult * result
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | [`DvzShaderCompileStatus`](runtime-shader.md#type-dvzshadercompilestatus) | compilation status |
| `request` | `const` [`DvzShaderCompileRequest`](runtime-shader.md#type-dvzshadercompilerequest) * | compilation request |
| `result` | [`DvzShaderCompileResult`](runtime-shader.md#type-dvzshadercompileresult) * |  |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/shader.h`:143._

#### `dvz_shader_compile_result_destroy()` { #dvz_shader_compile_result_destroy .dvz-api-function }

Destroy owned data in a shader compilation result and reset it.

This function is idempotent. The SPIR-V and diagnostic buffers use the Datoviz allocator and
follow the same ownership contract as dvz_memory_free().

```c
void dvz_shader_compile_result_destroy(
    DvzShaderCompileResult * result
);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `result` | [`DvzShaderCompileResult`](runtime-shader.md#type-dvzshadercompileresult) * | compilation result |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/shader.h`:155._

#### `dvz_shader_compiler_status()` { #dvz_shader_compiler_status .dvz-api-function }

Return the runtime shader compiler status without requiring a GPU context.

This function performs thread-safe, once-only provider discovery. A successful status means
runtime GLSL compilation is ready.

```c
DvzShaderCompileStatus dvz_shader_compiler_status(void);
```

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| return | [`DvzShaderCompileStatus`](runtime-shader.md#type-dvzshadercompilestatus) | current compiler status |

_Declared in `include/datoviz/shader.h`:98._
